scene.description: Engine 181 is supplied by a hydrant and is feeding a portable monitor with two equal 2½-inch lines at a commercial building.

sceneElements.engine: Engine 181 positioned on the street side of a commercial building
hoses: Hydrant supply line to Engine 181 intake; not included in pump discharge pressure calculation
Two equal 2½-inch discharge lines from Engine 181 to portable monitor

problems.title: Engine 181 Portable Master Stream
problems.question: Engine 181 is supplying a portable monitor with two equal 200 ft 2½-inch lines. The monitor is flowing 500 GPM total with a master-stream nozzle pressure of 80 PSI. Split the flow equally, use C = 2, and use the stated 15 PSI portable-monitor appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should the operator set?
formulaBreakdown: PP = 25 FL + 80 NP + 15 stated monitor loss = 120 PSI.
problems.instructorExplanation: Split the total flow between the two equal lines. Use one parallel path's friction loss, then add the specified nozzle pressure and scenario appliance loss.
problems.explainMistake: Do not calculate each line at the full 500 GPM or add the two parallel friction losses together.

problems.title: Engine 181 Portable Master Stream
problems.question: Engine 181 supplies the portable monitor at 600 GPM total through two equal 200 ft 2½-inch lines. Split the flow equally, use C = 2, use 80 PSI master-stream nozzle pressure, and add the stated 15 PSI portable-monitor appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should be set?
problems.instructorExplanation: At 600 GPM total, each equal supply line carries 300 GPM. Use one line's friction loss in the pressure path.
problems.explainMistake: Do not calculate each 2½-inch line at the full 600 GPM. The two equal lines each carry 300 GPM.

problems.title: Engine 181 Portable Master Stream
problems.question: Engine 181 supplies the portable monitor at 500 GPM total through two equal 250 ft 2½-inch lines. Split the flow equally, use C = 2, use 80 PSI master-stream nozzle pressure, and add the stated 15 PSI portable-monitor appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should be set?
problems.instructorExplanation: The 500 GPM total is split between two equal 250-ft supply lines; use one line's friction loss.
problems.explainMistake: Do not add both parallel line losses together.

problems.title: Engine 181 Portable Master Stream
problems.question: Engine 181 supplies the portable monitor at 500 GPM total through two equal 200 ft 2½-inch lines. Split the flow equally, use C = 2, use 80 PSI master-stream nozzle pressure, and add the stated 25 PSI portable-monitor appliance loss. What pump discharge pressure should be set?
problems.instructorExplanation: This variation explicitly assigns a 25 PSI appliance loss. Treat that as a scenario value, not a universal monitor loss.
problems.explainMistake: Use the appliance loss stated in this variation rather than reusing another scenario's value.
